content:
We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system likely has a sample molecule loaded as "the sample at hand". We can get carbon NMR spectra which may indicate aromatic carbons. But easier: use carbon_nmr_spectra to get list of carbon shifts; aromatic carbons typically around 110-160 ppm. Count them.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
